scope: Deterministic gzip archive containing selected stripped AArch64 binaries, manifest and usage text. These are regression ceilings for the current document app and toolchain; they exclude host libc, terminal emulator, kernel buffers and stored documents. Optional hosts are charged to their selected package, not the CLI-only package.
